annotations.text:
Reusable components — dc-import these into any slide, never redraw.
NumbersCard: 1–3 stats + a fixed n / period / market row.
HonestyCard: the "we don't know this one" treatment, same chrome as insufficient.html.

Carousel slide templates, 1080×1350. Hook and CTA carry bracket placeholder copy — content isn't final until the marketing strategy and humanizer pass land. Data slide is a worked example: Post 1's real numbers (New Balance 530), proving the template against real content, not lorem.

Reel frame templates, 1080×1920 — cover + end card only, no video assembly here (that's a separate job; these frames assume a 15s vertical clip with the same numbers spoken over it). Cover carries placeholder copy. The two end cards are worked examples, verbatim from QUEUE-INSTAGRAM-W1.md: Post 1 (confident numbers) and Post 3 (the honesty post) side by side, so the same card weight is visible on both.
